enrichment.headline: Pays $1,005,707 in November 2020 election costs for the Measure Y classroom repair and safety measure
enrichment.summary: The board approves paying $1,005,707.46 in costs for the November 3, 2020 election on Measure Y, the Classroom Repair/Safety Improvement Measure. Of that, $889,568.70 goes to the Alameda County Registrar of Voters, based on the district's number of registered voters, and $116,138.76 goes to Consolidated Printers, Inc., the Registrar's agent, for printing Measure Y in the voters' guide in five languages. Both are due April 5, 2021.

enrichment.summary: The district hires ENGEO to do geotechnical and engineering work for the Laurel Child Development Center Replacement Project, including soil borings, cone penetration tests, a seismic hazards analysis, soil sampling, lab testing and written reports. enrichment.headline: Adds $16,940 and extends Jensen Hughes' fire alarm consulting on the Fremont construction project
enrichment.summary: This amends the district's agreement with Jensen Hughes for the Fremont New Construction Project (Increment III). It adds site visits to witness a fire alarm re-test and attend a fire and intrusion alarm pre-pull meeting. The change adds $16,940.00, raising the limit from $86,430.00 to $103,370.00, and extends the term from December 31, 2020 to April 10, 2022; the original term had already ended by the date of this meeting.
